subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 18, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 18, 2026

The development team has resolved a geocode-glib update conflict that affected installed systems, merging the repair branch to ensure smooth package upgrades for all users. This fix prevents potential breakage during routine system updates and reflects our commitment to repository sovereignty.

Upstream changes continue to shape our roadmap as Redict has been officially deprecated in favor of Valkey following Drew DeVault's announcement. Meanwhile, Greg Kroah-Hartman released three stable kernels this week including versions 7.3.5 and 6.18.64, which will be integrated into our build pipeline.

Security updates from AlmaLinux arrived Tuesday covering .NET runtimes, bind, buildah, and cockpit components among others. Our team is also advancing local AI capabilities with new hardware detection and llama.cpp deployment tooling in the PRJCTNatalie repository.

The Natalie AI agent foundation has been scaffolded as we explore privacy-respecting artificial intelligence integration. Updated Wayland configurations in calamares-config-wayland now enforce Wayland as the default desktop session for improved security and performance.

A new firefox-fix package restores proper window position memory on Linux, while acreetion-surf version 2.0.0 landed with its initial commit. These quality-of-life improvements demonstrate our focus on polished daily driver experience.

Community infrastructure remains robust with both Natalie and Darren actively maintaining projects on our self-hosted GitLab instance at gitlab.acreetionos.org. The father-daughter co-lead team continues operating from Spokane, Washington with full transparency.

Our Discord server at discord.acreetionos.org serves as the primary support hub where users can engage directly with developers. The project maintains independence as a volunteer-run distribution with no corporate backing or telemetry.

AcreetionOS distinguishes itself through its Arch base with Cinnamon desktop and XLibre graphics stack, delivering privacy-first computing without lock-in. The Calamares installer customization ensures your first boot experience is flawless every time.

For new users, the installation guide at acreetionos.org/flash.html provides straightforward steps to sovereignty. Minimum requirements remain modest at 2GB RAM and 20GB storage on 6
